steps.command:
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# The managed Ubuntu 16.04 image advertises ESM repositories, but this
# disposable task has no ESM credentials. Disable those entries everywhere;
# the public Xenial repositories carry the MariaDB packages and dependencies.
for apt_source in /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.list; do
  if [ -f "$apt_source" ]; then
    sudo -n sed -i \
      '/^[[:space:]]*deb .*esm\.ubuntu\.com\/infra\/ubuntu xenial-infra-/s/^/# disabled for InfraSet task: /' \
      "$apt_source"
  fi
done
sudo -n rm -f /var/lib/apt/lists/*esm*
sudo -n apt-get update
sudo -n apt-get install -y mariadb-server mariadb-client
sudo -n systemctl enable --now mysql
sudo -n systemctl is-active mysql
steps.failure:
HTTPStatusError: Server error '524 <none>' for url 'https://antrieb.sh/mcp'
